preseason_hypothesis: Shough is the unquestioned QB1 and Year 2 development centerpiece
confirming_evidence: first-team reps; Moore/Nussmeier public commitment; efficient preseason operation
disconfirming_evidence: Zach Wilson or Spencer Rattler receives meaningful first-team competition; inefficient operation

preseason_hypothesis: Olave remains the clear target anchor after his extension
confirming_evidence: leads first-team routes and designed targets; used on third down and red zone
disconfirming_evidence: Tyson or another receiver matches first-read usage; injury limits routes

preseason_hypothesis: Tyson earns immediate starting perimeter routes opposite Olave
confirming_evidence: runs with first-team 11 personnel; routes at multiple depths; two-minute involvement
disconfirming_evidence: rotates behind Devaughn Vele or depth receivers; managed due to health

preseason_hypothesis: Etienne leads the backfield in total snaps while sharing receiving work with Kamara
confirming_evidence: first-team early downs; pass-protection trust; route share near or above Kamara
disconfirming_evidence: Kamara remains primary passing-down back; Kendre Miller or Devin Neal cuts early-down work

preseason_hypothesis: Kamara shifts from workhorse to high-leverage receiving and changeup role
confirming_evidence: two-minute routes; red-zone packages; fewer early-down carries
disconfirming_evidence: Kamara retains clear lead-back volume; Etienne used mostly as complement

preseason_hypothesis: Juwan Johnson/Noah Fant/Oscar Delp form a package-based TE rotation rather than one dominant fantasy role
confirming_evidence: routes and inline snaps split by package; no tight end dominates targets
disconfirming_evidence: one tight end exceeds 70 percent route share and target priority
review_trigger: after two games with route data

preseason_hypothesis: David Edwards and the young tackles improve Shough's protection floor
confirming_evidence: stable starting five; reduced interior pressure; cleaner third-down operation
disconfirming_evidence: guard competition persists; pressure disrupts timing

preseason_hypothesis: Brown's clearest early path is return specialist plus manufactured touches
confirming_evidence: wins KR/PR work; motion/screens in preseason
disconfirming_evidence: loses return job; inactive on game day
